name: There’s No Freaking Way I’ll be Your Fake Girlfriend!
source:
Manami Morino (森野 愛美, Morino Manami) is in a happy, committed relationship, but her uncle wants her to help out one of his clients by fake dating them.

No freaking way is she doing that!

Caught in a web of deception, Manami must find a way to untangle herself from these three men and get her life back to normal. All without her boyfriend finding out.

Can Manami escape this unscathed, or will everything go down in flames? 

[From [url=https://invisiblevampire.itch.io/fake-girlfriend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
森野真奈美（森野爱美饰）有着一段幸福、忠诚的关系，但她的叔叔希望她通过假约会来帮助他的一位客户。

她绝不会这么做！

陷入欺骗的网络中的真奈美必须找到一种方法来摆脱这三个男人的束缚，让她的生活恢复正常。这一切都没有被她的男朋友发现。

真奈美能否毫发无伤地逃脱，还是一切都会付诸东流？

[来自[url=https://invisiblevampire.itch.io/fake-girlfriend]itch.io[/url]]
